msg: Hi there! My wife and I are staying at a hotel in Barú next week. We're both certified divers (Advanced). Can you pick us up at the hotel? Is lunch included? How much for 2 dives?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Two dives in the Rosario Islands are a wonderful way to enjoy the reefs. If your hotel in Barú has boat access, pick-up and drop-off are included; in some cases the boat meets you at the hotel, and in others we’ll indicate the nearest dock or meeting point. Lunch isn’t included for departures from the islands.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena*
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD (1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)
*Already on the Rosario Islands*
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD (440.000 COP · 489.000 COP)
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 188 USD · 209 USD (665.000 COP · 739.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD (720.000 COP · 800.000 COP)

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: We're at the Decameron in Barú. We just want the 2 dives, both of us. Where do we meet the boat?
reply:
Since you’re staying in Barú, you’ll depart from Cartagena. The boat meets at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.; there’s no hotel pick-up, so you’ll need to get to the dock yourselves.

For the one who hasn't chosen yet I'd recommend these options. Which one do they like best? 🐠
• *Certified diving* — Guided dives for already-certified divers; explore the reef at depth.
• *Dive mini-course* — A first time underwater with an instructor: pool training and a real dive. No experience needed.
• *Open Water course* — Entry certification course: qualifies you to dive independently down to 18 m.
• *Snorkeling* — Enjoy the reef from the surface, with mask and fins. Great for families.
• *Come along as a companion* — Comes on the boat and enjoys the day with the group, without getting in the water.
